purpose: Freeze the full external-validation protocol BEFORE any SC-M01 outcome is read. No SC-M01 outcome may be read before this file exists and is hashed.
final_tabdpt_training_manifest: G5 frozen TabDPT manifest: features=[WCR,GP_MPa,grout_take_L_per_m,grouting_time_h,depth_m,section_length_m,pre_lugeon], target=log1p(post_lugeon), TabDPTRegressor(device=cpu), all 6 development mines
final_catboost_training_manifest: G5 frozen CatBoost: iterations=1000, depth=6, learning_rate=0.05, loss_function=RMSE, random_seed=20260822, all 6 development mines

uq_b_algorithm.distribution: mine-balanced empirical distribution (each mine equal total weight)

representative_rule: conservative (min f1) / resource_saving (min f2) / balanced (closest to normalized centroid); one decision + role_set
cross_model_verification_rule: Level-B = TREE_UCB_SAFE AND TABDPT_AUDIT_UCB_SAFE AND ENGINEERING_PASS AND SUPPORT_PASS
bootstrap_ci_rule: single external mine => NO cross-site bootstrap CI; optional pre-specified borehole-cluster bootstrap labelled 'within-external-mine cluster uncertainty' only
no_adaptation_rule: No SC-M01 outcome may re-select model / UQ / alpha / support / bounds / optimizer / budget / representative rule / abstention rule.
sc_m01_outcome_access: FORBIDDEN until g8_preoutcome_freeze.json records SC_M01_OUTCOME_ACCESSED=FALSE and a test confirms no forbidden column is loaded.
